implementation.notes: Part of the jt680x module set inside the jtcores monorepo. License: https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/LICENSE (GPLv3 text) plus the "or (at your option) any later version" grant in https://github.com/jotego/jtcores/blob/master/modules/jt680x/hdl/jt65c02.v. Linked to r65c02 as well as the base m65c02 because the microcode source modules/jt680x/ucode/65c02.yaml defines the Rockwell-only RMB/SMB/BBR/BBS bit instructions (36 opcodes) on top of the standard 65C02 set. accuracy_id omitted: no fidelity claim in the repo.
